svg.title: Resuming restores state. It replays effects.
svg.desc: A hand-drawn timeline of five nodes - triage, gather, diagnose, CHARGE and report - with a checkpoint cylinder after each completed node holding 3.2 KB of state, and a jagged red lightning bolt striking inside CHARGE labelled SIGTERM at 41 seconds. Below, a new process loads thread_id inc-4412 from the checkpoint before CHARGE and re-enters it, and two red arrows reach the bank: 240 pounds charged, then 240 pounds charged AGAIN, with the bank crossed out and 'this is the bug' written beside it. The fix is drawn in green: write an intent carrying a derived uuid5 idempotency key into an outbox queue, and let one worker be the only thing that touches money and dedupe on the key.
svg.text: Resuming restores state. It replays effects.
checkpoint after every node - state 3.2 KB
20 kills: 6 double charges without a key, 0 with one
the worker is the ONLY thing that touches money, and it dedupes on the key
the key must be DERIVED, not random.
A random uuid regenerates on resume
checkpoint write p50 1.9 ms local / 4.7 ms same-AZ
9 checkpoints per run = 42 ms on a 34 s run = 0.12%
...and what if it never crashes, just never
